lab: Lab 1 -- archlab (v0.6 territory, FAMILY CONSTANT directive 2026-08-09 08:30Z, LAUNCH APPROVED 10:55Z)
stage: PRE-REGISTERED test of whether the recall-reach law is a GENERAL provisioning law with a per-architecture-family constant alpha (W_eff = alpha * W), rather than decay-attention-specific (the bb/bc FAMILY_SPECIFIC limitation). Inverted design: window W held FIXED per shard, retrieval distance d swept by the sealed eval; readout is the per-distance accuracy curve acc(d) and the collapse distance d_collapse per family.
hypothesis: Each architecture family has a stable effective-reach constant alpha: decay attention (GLA) alpha=1 (p1d Battery B, natural text); plain windowed softmax attention alpha>1 (bb/bc: 24 in-window transitions, 0 ceiling confirmations, transitioned runs recall 0.89-1.0 past geometric ceilings). If alpha is a stable per-family constant, the law becomes general with one measurable material constant per family.

panel_distance_grid.note: distances are even values in [4,32]; per-distance query counts n_d = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,1] for d=4,6,...,32 (64 queries/sample x 384 samples = 24576 queries total). Max observable distance = 32, so d_collapse is only measurable if <= 32.

budget_rationale: 3e16 is the bb-proven plain-attention easy48 transition budget (win20 6/8, win28 5/8 transitioned). Windowed-GLA transition on this panel is being confirmed by a pre-seal pilot (seed 990001, scratch salt, W=14) launched 11:12Z before this seal; the GLA arm's budget is gated on that pilot reaching recall > 0.8. If the pilot underperforms, the GLA arm budget is raised to 6e16 by registered amendment BEFORE launch -- never after data.

families.plain: windowed PLAIN softmax attention (cand_windowed_softmax.py; no decay/conv/norm; RoPE; sliding-window causal mask, exclusive boundary d<W)
families.gla: windowed decay attention / GLA (cand_windowed_gla.py; data-dependent scalar-per-head decay, conv, output norm; SAME exclusive sliding-window mask so both families share one instrument)

anchor: gla arm is the alpha=1 anchor on the SAME synthetic instrument as the plain arm (directive item 6 -- the comparison must be between families, not instruments; p1d already measured alpha=1 on natural text).
depth_sweep: plain-attention arm swept over depth L in {4,8,12} at fixed W=14 (directive item 5: if alpha comes from multi-layer relay / induction-head formation, alpha grows with depth; if a fixed block property, it does not). Direct test of the mechanism the Forgetting Transformer author (Zhixuan Lin, email 2026-08-06) proposed for the base-config failure (too few layers to form induction heads).

shards.role: primary plain-attention alpha measurement (reference depth L=8)
depth sweep low (L=4) + second control arm
alpha=1 anchor arm (windowed GLA) on the same instrument

design_notes.fixed_window: W=14 held fixed on all candidate shards (directive item 1: inverted, NOT window-varying -- varying W is what confounded campaign ar). Distance is swept by the eval, not the window.
design_notes.window_choice: W=14 is from the range that actually transitioned in bb/bc (win14: 10/16 at 6e16; win10 stayed underpowered at both budgets and is excluded per directive item 4). W=14 at the 3e16 primary budget is borderline (bb win14 transitioned 2/8 at 3e16); see escalation_ladder.
design_notes.alpha_resolution: distance grid is even integers; a collapse between d=2k and d=2k+2 localizes d_collapse to one step (2 tokens), so alpha = d_collapse/W is resolved to +/-(1/W).
design_notes.transition_gating: directive item 3 (mandatory): alpha is read ONLY from transitioned runs (per-run in-window accuracy > 0.8, bb's bimodality-corrected signal). A family/cell with too few transitions yields no alpha (not alpha=0). Transition counts reported separately per arm.
design_notes.depth_reception_caveat: at depth L, information can relay across layers, so the ARCHITECTURE's reach can exceed the single-layer window W. alpha>1 for plain attention is the multi-layer-relay signature; the depth sweep tests whether alpha tracks L.

alpha_gla.basis: p1d Battery B (natural text): intact at d=W exactly (0.922/1.000/0.906 across W=128/256/512), chance at d=W+1 (0.016/0.000/0.031). Sharp, three windows, independent.
alpha_gla.predicted_curve: acc(d) ~ 1.0 for d < W=14, collapsing to chance at d >= 14

alpha_plain_L8.basis: bb/bc: transitioned plain-attention runs recall 0.89-1.0 well past their geometric ceilings; win14 transitioned runs held ~1.0 out-of-window accuracy across d=14..32 (no collapse observed up to the panel max), win28 held 0.70-0.77 out-of-window. Reach extends past W by at least ~2x at W=14; a sharp collapse was never observed, so the point estimate carries a registered range.
alpha_plain_L8.predicted_curve: acc(d) ~ high for d well past W=14, collapsing toward chance around d ~ 28 (= 2*W)

alpha_plain_depth_trend.prediction: alpha_plain is non-decreasing in depth L (4 <= 8 <= 12) if the mechanism is multi-layer relay / induction-head formation (Lin's hypothesis); flat if alpha is a fixed block property.

preregistered_gate.chance_ceiling_note: a distance d is 'collapsed' if acc(d) <= 0.15 (chance 0.0625 plus a small margin); 'intact' if acc(d) >= 0.8; between is 'partial'.
preregistered_gate.min_transitions_note: fewer than 3 transitioned runs in an arm => that arm is UNDERPOWERED (no alpha read), triggering the escalation ladder, NOT alpha=0.
preregistered_gate.d_collapse_definition: largest distance d with acc(d) >= 0.8 among transitioned runs, pooled per arm; d_collapse is then that d, and the collapse boundary is the first distance past it with acc <= 0.15.
gates: G0_control: control arm (transformer_full, shards 0+3 pooled, 16 runs) must reach recall > 0.8 in >= 12/16 runs -- the instrument is solvable. If G0 fails the campaign is INSTRUMENT_SUSPECT, no family claim.

G1_anchor: gla arm -- among transitioned runs, alpha_gla = d_collapse/W == 1.0 within resolution (d_collapse in {12,14}, i.e. collapse at the window edge). PASS reproduces the alpha=1 anchor on the synthetic instrument.

G2_plain_alpha: plain L8 arm -- among transitioned runs (>=3 required), a clean collapse exists (some d with acc>=0.8 and a larger d with acc<=0.15) AND alpha_plain in [1.5, 3.0] AND alpha_plain > alpha_gla. PASS confirms alpha_plain > 1 (plain attention reaches past its window) with a measured constant.
G3_depth: alpha_plain ordering across L in {4,8,12} is non-decreasing. PASS supports the multi-layer-relay / induction-head mechanism (Lin). Recorded as the observed ordering regardless.
G4_stability: the FAMILY_CONSTANT verdict requires G0 AND G1 AND G2 all PASS -- alpha is a stable, measurable, family-distinguishing constant. Verdict branches enumerated in PAPER-NOTE.md.

verdict_definitions.FAMILY_CONSTANT_CONFIRMED: G0+G1+G2 PASS: alpha_gla=1 anchor reproduced AND alpha_plain measured in [1.5,3.0] (>alpha_gla) with a clean collapse. The reach law is GENERAL with a per-family constant.
verdict_definitions.ALPHA_NOT_STABLE: plain arm shows no clean collapse (accuracy decays gradually, no distance satisfies the collapse definition) OR per-seed d_collapse spread exceeds the resolution band -- alpha is not a well-defined constant for plain attention.
verdict_definitions.PLAIN_REACH_IS_WINDOW: alpha_plain measured at ~1 (collapse at the window edge), contradicting bb/bc's ceiling overshoot -- the bb/bc overshoot was an optimization artifact, not extended reach.
verdict_definitions.UNDERPOWERED: any arm yields < min_transitions transitioned runs after the escalation ladder; no alpha read for that arm.

escalation_ladder: If any candidate arm yields < 3 transitioned runs at 3e16 (UNDERPOWERED), re-run THAT arm at 6e16 with fresh seeds continuing the seed block (bb->bc precedent), same sealed salt and instrument. The escalation is a budget change only; the alpha definition, gates, and predictions are unchanged. Registered now so it is not a post-hoc amendment.
